newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangzhou Shipyard sees 1996 turnover up 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Shipyard sees 1996 turnover up 20 pct.

text.p: Guangzhou Shipyard International Co expects turnover in 1996 to reach an historic high of 2.09 billion yuan, up 19.85 percent on 1995, a company official said on Monday.
But the official said 1996 net profits would not rise as a result, mainly because of increases in raw material prices and a reduction in the export tax rebate. He declined to give further details.

In 1996, the company built ships totalling 234,400 tonnes, three times more than the previous year, and sales volume rose to 2.08 billion yuan, up 19.8 percent on 1995, the official said but gave no other details.
